description: Source code for rendering and listing installed fonts in a PDF using PDFsharp library, including classes RenderInstalledFonts and RenderInstalledFontsSnippet with methods for multi-page rendering and font exclusion logic.

classes.name: RenderInstalledFonts
classes.description: Main class providing method to run font rendering test and generate PDF with font snippets.

classes.name: RenderInstalledFontsSnippet
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering font samples into PDF pages, managing font list, exclusions, and multi-page rendering.

methods.name: RenderInstalledFontsTest
methods.description: Initiates rendering of font snippets into PDF.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdf
methods.description: Static method to render font snippets as multi-page PDF and save/show file.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders font samples onto a graphics object, including font name and style samples.

methods.name: RenderSnippetMultiPage
methods.description: Prepares font list and renders multiple pages of font samples.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdfMultiPage
methods.description: Creates a PDF document and renders multiple font pages into it.

methods.name: TryDrawString
methods.description: Attempts to draw a font sample string with specific style, handling exclusions and exceptions.

methods.name: IsFontExcluded
methods.description: Checks if a font with a specific style is excluded based on exclusion lists and font encoding.
